scenarios.live_claim: A drought-to-flood transition threatens water access, seed stocks, a clinic and a wetland that buffers the flood.
scenarios.discriminating_question: Can a policy preserve vital access and the wetland without hiding a single common failure or shifting the burden to exposed workers?
scenarios.rival_favorable_prediction: A centralized emergency administrator may restore clinic power faster when local redundancy is initially incomplete.
scenarios.reversal_condition: Withdraw the margin rule if distributed reserves repeatedly delay vital restoration without reducing common-failure loss.

scenarios.live_claim: A worker cooperative network acquires suppliers, credit channels and a data platform, then converts democratic status into a durable investment veto.
scenarios.discriminating_question: Can the CCT distinguish cooperative legal form from actual concentration and remove the veto without destroying livelihood continuity?
scenarios.rival_favorable_prediction: A social-market regulator may retain more short-run investment capacity if socialization disrupts supplier coordination.
scenarios.reversal_condition: Withdraw the socialization trigger if it changes titles but does not reduce effective control, rents or vetoes.

scenarios.live_claim: A formally neutral eligibility procedure grants temporary continuity protections through organizations, but access and renewal differ across groups for administrative reasons.
scenarios.discriminating_question: Can a policy detect and repair a disparity without converting group identity into proof of collective guilt or exposing people through nominal lists?
scenarios.rival_favorable_prediction: A centralized administrator may equalize processing times faster, while a decentralised process may better preserve confidential recourse.
scenarios.reversal_condition: Withdraw the data rule if its aggregation prevents detection of a material disparity or if disclosure creates a predictable safety harm.

scenarios.live_claim: Food, medicine, power and communications appear redundant but depend on the same port, fuel supplier and scheduling system.
scenarios.discriminating_question: Can a policy expose the shared dependency, preserve minimum access and create a repair path before the outage becomes irreversible?
scenarios.rival_favorable_prediction: A centralized emergency administrator may ration a single remaining route more quickly than a distributed coordination system.
scenarios.reversal_condition: Withdraw the distributed-reserve rule if its material cost worsens shortages without improving access or recovery under matched constraints.
